description: This PHP source file defines a class for viewing a Gantt chart within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for rendering HTML and JavaScript to display project tasks and resources, and handles retrieval of project template data and linked resources.

classes.name: AM_ProjectTemplatesViewGanttChart
classes.description: A view class extending ViewDetail responsible for displaying a Gantt chart for project templates, including rendering HTML components, JavaScript integrations, and data retrieval.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the Gantt chart view, including HTML, JavaScript, and embedded PHP to manage project resource data and task pop-ups.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Calculates the time span between two dates in months and days, returning a formatted string.
